sub_intents.name: Birthday reward
sub_intents.classification_hint: User asks how to apply for or claim birthday bonus/reward, or asks what birthday promotions are available.

sub_intents.name: Red packet / named campaign
sub_intents.classification_hint: User asks about a specific named promotion, returning-member campaign, red packet, or deposit bonus offer (e.g. deposit 1000 get 500).

sub_intents.name: Eligibility / rejected application
sub_intents.classification_hint: User reports a failed or rejected promotion/bonus application, or asks why they are not eligible.

sub_intents.name: Card application or cancellation
sub_intents.classification_hint: User asks about applying for, cancelling, or declining a payment card, or what happens if an application is not approved.

sub_intents.name: Cannot log in / access platform
sub_intents.classification_hint: User cannot open, log in, or access the platform; includes IP blocks and login errors.

sub_intents.name: Duplicate / multiple accounts
sub_intents.classification_hint: User discusses having multiple accounts, household members with separate accounts, or duplicate account issues.

sub_intents.name: Forgot password
sub_intents.classification_hint: User asks how to view, recover, or reset their password.

sub_intents.name: Change phone / name / profile
sub_intents.classification_hint: User wants to update profile info, rebind account, change bank account details, phone number, or name.

sub_intents.name: Account locked / suspended / disabled
sub_intents.classification_hint: User reports account closed, blacklisted, suspended, locked, or disabled by the platform.

sub_intents.name: Unclassified within account
sub_intents.classification_hint: Account-related question that does not fit other sub-intents, such as account closure requests.

sub_intents.name: Withdrawal and deposit service availability
sub_intents.classification_hint: User asks whether deposit and/or withdrawal services are working normally right now, without a specific failed transaction.

sub_intents.name: Transaction status
sub_intents.classification_hint: User asks whether a deposit or withdrawal is completed, pending, failed, or needs action.

sub_intents.name: Transaction problem or complaint
sub_intents.classification_hint: User reports a failed, delayed, incorrect, or confusing transaction or service problem.

sub_intents.name: How to deposit
sub_intents.classification_hint: User asks how to use a deposit method (ATM payment, bank transfer steps, where to click).

sub_intents.name: USDT deposit guidance
sub_intents.classification_hint: User asks for USDT/crypto deposit instructions or tutorial.

sub_intents.name: Deposit methods / limits / fees
sub_intents.classification_hint: User asks about deposit amount limits, minimums, fees, or why a specific amount is required.

sub_intents.name: Proof submitted / manual posting
sub_intents.classification_hint: User asks whether they must contact support or submit proof for each deposit to be credited.

sub_intents.name: Funds not credited
sub_intents.classification_hint: User reports deposited funds have not been credited to their account yet.

sub_intents.name: Incorrect amount / payment details
sub_intents.classification_hint: Transferred amount does not match the amount entered on the deposit form.

sub_intents.name: Convenience-store deposit
sub_intents.classification_hint: Issue with convenience-store (超商) payment: lost receipt, tracing payment, store location.

sub_intents.name: Unclassified within deposit
sub_intents.classification_hint: General deposit question that does not clearly fit other sub-intents, such as deposit timing or method confusion.

sub_intents.name: Top-up and deposit flow
sub_intents.classification_hint: User wants to add balance and needs the amount, payment destination, proof, or completion flow.

sub_intents.name: Payment destination and account details
sub_intents.classification_hint: User asks which bank account or payment destination to use.

sub_intents.name: Transfer receipt and payment proof
sub_intents.classification_hint: User submits a receipt or payment proof and wants acknowledgement or verification.

sub_intents.name: Daily task not completed after wagering
sub_intents.classification_hint: User completed wagering/bets but daily task still shows incomplete.

sub_intents.name: Bonus withdrawal limit
sub_intents.classification_hint: User asks about limits on withdrawing promotional/bonus credit.

sub_intents.name: Withdrawal pending / not received
sub_intents.classification_hint: User reports a withdrawal that is pending too long or has not arrived in their bank account.

sub_intents.name: Bongkar or withdrawal request
sub_intents.classification_hint: User wants to withdraw, convert, or cash out a balance using terms such as bongkar, tarik, WD, or cairin.

sub_intents.name: Rules / terms / policy
sub_intents.classification_hint: User asks about platform rules, turnover/wagering requirements, terms, or meaning of policy terms.

sub_intents.name: Customer-service hours / contact methods
sub_intents.classification_hint: User asks for customer service contact info, hours, or official support account.

sub_intents.name: Platform navigation / feature location
sub_intents.classification_hint: User needs help finding a feature, downloading the app, or navigating the platform.

sub_intents.name: General help and how-to
sub_intents.classification_hint: User asks about a process, rule, requirement, limit, method, or next step.

sub_intents.name: Price list and payment
sub_intents.classification_hint: User asks about Royal Dream prices, payment destinations, QRIS, confirmation, or transfer-proof rules.
